properties.name: jeap.postgresql.aws.enabled
properties.description: Flag to enable the jEAP Postgresql AWS Starter.

properties.name: jeap.datasource.aws.database-name
properties.description: Name of the database the read-only replica datasource connects to. If empty, the database name is taken from the primary datasource configuration.

properties.name: jeap.datasource.aws.wrapper.target-data-source-properties.wrapperDialect
properties.description: Database dialect used by the AWS Advanced JDBC Wrapper. Defaults to 'aurora-pg'; set to 'rds-pg' for standard RDS PostgreSQL.

properties.name: jeap.datasource.aws.wrapper.target-data-source-properties.socketTimeout
properties.description: AWS wrapper socket read timeout in milliseconds for primary and replica connections (converted to seconds for pgJDBC). No default is set by the starter; configure according to application query and lock-wait durations. Set to 0 to disable. This is not the HikariCP validation or connection acquisition timeout.
